title: Hatari agent console — Console tab
subtitle: Hatari agent console (tools/agent/hatari_gui.py) · Falcon030 running Spectral Keep · agent API :7790

items.label: Toolbar
items.text: Pause, Resume, run one frame or one second, cold reset and save a screenshot, plus a fast-forward toggle; each is one agent API call.

items.label: Live emulator screen
items.text: The /screen image polled every 150 ms at 1-3x zoom; clicking, dragging and typing on it are sent to the Atari as mouse and key input.

items.label: Program console
items.text: Text the Atari program prints through NatFeats, read from GET /console: here Spectral Keep's KEEP log lines with fps, room and per-frame timings.

items.label: Status line
items.text: Emulator state, frame counter, PC, machine and TOS, screen mode, the GEM mouse position and the last debugger stop, from GET /status.
